description: The donut chart illustrates the composition of the Darija Open Dataset, Version 2, with six distinct categories represented by colored segments. The largest segment, colored yellow, corresponds to "Translated Sentences" and is labeled with the value 45,387. The second largest segment, in green, represents "Pending Translations" with a value of 43,000. The third largest segment, in dark blue, is labeled "Extra + Augmented Data" and shows a value of 30,000. The fourth segment, in orange, represents "Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)" with a value of 23,108. The smallest segment, a thin purple slice, is labeled "Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)" and has a value of 1,000. The smallest segment, a thin red slice, is labeled "Moroccan Names" and has a value of 1,000. A legend on the right side of the chart matches each color to its corresponding category. The chart visually emphasizes the relative proportions of these data components, with the "Translated Sentences" and "Pending Translations" categories being the most significant.
